corrections.what: The 10 November item on a ship attacked in UAE waters, and the Iran war and Hormuz conflict texts, said ADNOC confirmed the damaged vessel was its own
corrections.was: ADNOC Logistics and Services said one of its vessels was damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters.
corrections.now: An Emirati ship was attacked and damaged in UAE territorial waters, and ADNOC Logistics and Services said response efforts were under way, without confirming the ship was its own.
corrections.why: The source's wording was overstated when summarised; found in today's verification pass.

corrections.what: Yemen conflict said the Houthis held the whole Red Sea coast to Bab al-Mandeb, missing the government's October recapture of Dhubab
corrections.was: The Houthis hold the whole Red Sea coast to Bab al-Mandeb and Perim Island.
corrections.now: The Houthis took the coast in September; government forces retook Dhubab and nearby areas north of the strait in early October, then announced a withdrawal from Dhubab and the Bab al-Mandeb area on 15 November.
corrections.why: The October counter-offensive on the coast was not reflected when the situation text was rewritten.

corrections.what: News item overstated what Trump said about military aid to Israel
corrections.was: Trump said he and Netanyahu had agreed that Washington would end its roughly 4 billion dollars a year in military aid after 2026.
corrections.now: Trump told Fox News that aid 'gets cut off at the end of the year' but did not say which forms of aid would end or how; Israel did not confirm any deal, and the 2016 agreement and a 2020 law set aid levels to 2028.
corrections.why: The first version relied on a secondary roundup rather than the interview and wire reports.

corrections.why: The cited article was from 2016 and described a plot against a previous government.
